Title: Memorization vs. Generalization in Deep Learning
Summary: The video explores whether deep networks generalize or merely memorize data, citing a study where a network achieved high training accuracy on shuffled labels. It contrasts this with structured data, where accuracy drops rapidly, indicating easier optimization. A follow-up paper shows that local minima on structured data are of equal quality, suggesting that learning is more efficient when data has inherent structure.
